comment: Canonical backup source set. Read by scripts/backup.py (CLI) and stack/backup.js (dashboard). `root` selects the base dir; `rel` is relative to it. `kind` file|dir. `toggle` entries are opt-in and skipped by the CLI. `backup: false` entries are never written to archives and never restored; they stay listed so archives made before the exclusion still validate, and the target install keeps its own copy. `restore: cli-only` marks files the dashboard API must not write (needs root/unit restarts it can't do).
